notes.note: Cameron lost the hit out count to Meek but he did have 16 disposals around the ground and 6 clearances. He hasn't been under 90 since round 17 still.
Cameron copped a knock to the ribs but played on to end with 24 disposals and 30 hit outs. This extends his run to four over 120 from the last five.
Cameron has been very good over the last three weeks and had the great match up against the Cats this week. The key is he is getting possession with 22 and had 7 marks.

Cameron has gone from strength to strength in recent weeks with a huge 154 this week form his 9 tackles 23 disposals and 37 hit outs. He had an equal high 18 contested possessions and he had 6 clearances.
Cameron was solid against the inexperienced Reidy with 39 hit outs and 8 clearances to his name. He will find it a little tougher against McAndrew next week who restricted Grundy's influence.
Cameron was fantastic with his best score since round 11. He led the team with 10 clearances and he led with 15 contested possessions.
Despite the friendly matchup we didn't see a big game from Cameron. Just 13 disposals to go with the 21 hit outs. Time to upgrade him if you can.
Cameron struggled against Sweet having just 11 disposals and 11 hit outs. Could be one to possibly upgrade
Cameron came home hard with a 36 in each of the last two quarters after being quiet in the first half.
Cameron had a solid game against English with 22 disposals and 24 hit outs. He was a popular trade for those that had Grundy.
Cameron was a popular trade in this week and he paid dividends for people with his best score of the year. 21 contested possessions and 8 clearances to go with 28 disposals.
Darcy copped a few knocks in the game and may miss some time potentially. He battled to 14 disposals and 12 hit outs. Could be time to trade if he misses.
Cameron couldn't take advantage of the inexperienced Bomber rucks. 17 hitouts and 15 disposals but his lowest in the last three.
Cameron backed up last week's good game with another. 20 hit outs and 18 disposals for him as he won the battle with Pittonet around the ground.

After two very quiet games we have seen Cameron come back to his best to have the third top score for the Pies. This did surprise us as he came up against Jackson. Hopefully this is the turn of form for him.
Cameron posted his second 59 in a row as he is still struggling to score with these new rules. He is also still splitting time with Oscar Steene.
Cameron had his hands full with the young Crow ruck as he was beaten in the hitouts and had to rely on his around the ground play.
Cameron was solid against TDK. Look for him to be a solid scorer again this season.
